DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご相談の用件を、簡単にお聞きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Pakisabi po nang maikli kung ano ang nais ninyong ikonsulta.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この欄に工場と書きましたが、働いている場所だけでは相談内容が分かりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 相談内容に職種だけ書いたと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Factory ang isinulat ko sa kahong ito, pero ang lugar lang ng trabaho ay hindi nagpapaliwanag kung ano ang gusto kong ikonsulta, tama po ba?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihing uri lang ng trabaho ang naisulat mo sa dahilan ng konsultasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 工場のお仕事で、どんなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ano po ang problemang nararanasan ninyo sa trabaho sa factory?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 来月から開始が一時間早くなると言われました。子どもを保育園へ送る時刻と重なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 勤務変更による保育送迎の困り事を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Sinabihan akong isang oras na mas maaga magsisimula ang trabaho mula sa susunod na buwan. Kasabay iyon ng oras ng paghatid ko sa anak ko sa daycare.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang problema sa paghatid ng anak dahil sa pagbabago ng oras ng trabaho. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 会社からの案内と、ご本人のご希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Pakisabi ang abiso ng kumpanya at kung ano ang gusto ninyo mismo.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 変更すると言われた紙はこちらです。私は元の開始時刻を希望していますが、会社へはまだ返事をしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 会社決定と本人希望を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ito ang papel na nagsasabing magbabago ang oras. Gusto kong manatili sa dating oras ng pagsisimula, pero hindi pa ako sumasagot sa kumpanya.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang pasya ng kumpanya sa sarili mong kagustuhan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 相談で、まず何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ano po ang una ninyong gustong malinawan sa konsultasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 会社へ事情を伝える時、開始時刻について何を質問しておくとよいかを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 相談で確かめたい質問を一つに絞る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Gusto kong kumonsulta kung ano ang dapat kong itanong tungkol sa oras ng pagsisimula kapag ipinaliwanag ko sa kumpanya ang sitwasyon ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ituon sa isang punto ang tanong na gusto mong malinawan sa konsultasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その質問を担当へおつなぎします。契約の資料もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ipapasa ko ang tanong na iyan sa namamahala. Pakidala rin ang mga dokumento ng kontrata.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 用件欄を勤務開始の変更と送迎の相談に直します。会社の紙と契約を示し、返答前に質問の整理をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 用件欄を具体的に直して担当へ出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Babaguhin ko ang dahilan ng konsultasyon sa pagbabago ng oras ng pagsisimula ng trabaho at paghatid ng anak. Ipapakita ko ang papel ng kumpanya at ang kontrata, at hihingi ng tulong sa pag-aayos ng mga tanong bago ako sumagot.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Gawing tiyak ang dahilan sa form at isumite ito sa namamahala. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: その内容で受け付けました。資料をそろえて相談席へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Tinanggap ko ang konsultasyon ayon sa impormasyong iyan. Ihanda po ang mga dokumento at magtungo sa puwesto ng konsultasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 乾燥機の表示についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Tungkol po ba sa display ng dryer ang tanong ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: もうすぐ終わると思ったのに、残りが四十分になっています。私の分に時間が足されたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 乾燥時間が急に長くなったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Akala ko patapos na, pero apatnapung minuto ang natitira sa display. Nadagdagan po ba ang oras para sa mga damit ko?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Magtanong tungkol sa biglang paghabang oras ng pagpapatuyo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お使いの機械の番号を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Maaari po bang tingnan ang numero ng makinang ginagamit ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 最初に撮った写真では六番です。今見ていたのは七番でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 使用番号の写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Anim ang numero sa litratong kinuha ko noong nagsimula. Pito pala ang tinitingnan ko ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang litrato ng numero. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 六番はこちらです。七番は別のお客様のご利用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Narito po ang numero anim. Ibang kostumer ang gumagamit ng numero pito.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 隣の表示を見ていました。七番には触らず、六番の残り五分を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 隣機の表示を見ていたと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Display pala ng katabing makina ang tinitingnan ko. Hindi ko hahawakan ang numero pito; titiyakin ko ang natitirang limang minuto sa numero anim.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihing naunawaan mong display ng katabing makina ang tinitingnan mo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 乾き具合は終了後に確認してください。追加する時も衣類の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Tingnan po kung gaano na katuyo ang damit pagkatapos ng siklo. Kung magdadagdag ng oras, tingnan din ang mga label ng damit.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 乾燥し過ぎたくない衣類があります。まず取り出して状態を見てから、追加する物だけ分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分の機械の追加時間が必要か衣類表示で考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: May mga damit akong ayaw kong sobrang matuyo. Ilalabas ko muna at titingnan ang kondisyon, saka ihihiwalay ang mga kailangan pang patuyuin.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Isaalang-alang kung kailangan pang dagdagan ang oras sa sarili mong makina ayon sa mga label ng damit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 終了前に扉を開けず、機械の案内に沿ってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Huwag po munang buksan ang pinto bago matapos. Maghintay ayon sa mga tagubilin ng makina.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 六番が終わったら自分の物だけ出します。写真の番号を見て、次も隣の機械と間違えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 自分の機械だけ終了後に取り出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Kapag natapos ang numero anim, sarili kong damit lamang ang kukunin ko. Titingnan ko ang numero sa litrato para hindi ko na mapagkamalan ang katabing makina sa susunod.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Kunin lamang ang sarili mong damit mula sa sarili mong makina pagkatapos nitong matapos. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 六番の終了をお待ちください。衣類と、ご使用のかごを忘れずにお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Hintayin po ninyong matapos ang numero anim. Huwag kalimutang iuwi ang mga damit at ang basket na ginamit ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 追加のご注文でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: May gusto po ba kayong idagdag sa order?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 先ほど頼んだ肉が来ていないので、同じ物をもう二皿お願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 追加した肉が来ていないと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hindi pa dumarating ang karneng inorder ko kanina, kaya gusto ko sanang umorder ng dalawa pang plato ng parehong karne.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Magtanong tungkol sa karagdagang karneng hindi pa raw dumarating. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お手元の皿と注文の記録を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Titingnan ko po ang mga plato sa mesa ninyo at ang rekord ng order.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この皿は最初の注文と思っていました。札には追加で頼んだ方の名前がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 卓上皿の注文名を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Akala ko mula sa unang order ang platong ito. Nasa tag pala ang pangalan ng karneng idinagdag namin sa order.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang label ng nasa mesa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その皿が追加分です。まだ焼いていないため、残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Iyan po ang idinagdag ninyong order. Nandiyan pa dahil hindi pa ninyo naihaw.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 来ていないのではなく、焼く前の肉だったんですね。二皿を追加する前に量を考え直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 未提供ではなく未焼成の肉と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hindi pala ito hindi dumating; ito ang karneng hindi pa namin naihaw. Gusto kong pag-isipang muli ang dami bago magdagdag ng dalawang plato.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihing naunawaan mong naihain na ang karne ngunit hindi pa naihaw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今の追加はまだ通していません。必要な分をご指定ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hindi ko pa po naipapasa ang bagong dagdag na order. Pakisabi kung gaano karami ang kailangan ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 卓上の分を食べてからにしたいですが、友人用に別の肉を一皿だけ頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 現在の量を見て追加を減らしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Gusto ko sanang kainin muna ang nasa mesa, pero puwede bang umorder ng isang plato lamang ng ibang karne para sa kaibigan ko?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Isaalang-alang ang dami ng nasa mesa at hilinging bawasan ang dagdag na order. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そちらのお肉一皿ですね。種類はこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Isang plato po ng karneng iyon, tama? Ito po ba ang uri na gusto ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい。既に来た皿は焼いて食べ、新しい追加はこの種類一皿だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 既提供分を焼き追加一皿だけ注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Opo. Iihawin at kakainin namin ang mga dumating na, at isang plato lamang ng ganitong uri ang bagong idadagdag.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Sabihing iihawin ang naihain nang karne at isang plato lamang ang idadagdag sa order. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 追加はこの一皿で承りました。先ほどの同じ肉二皿は注文に入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Isang plato lamang nito ang tinanggap kong dagdag na order. Hindi kasama sa order ang dalawang plato ng parehong karne na sinabi ninyo kanina.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 現在お使いのお薬はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 海外で買った薬を昨日飲みました。名前を日本語で読めないので、この箱の写真を見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 海外の薬名が読めず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Uminom kahapon ng binili abroad. Hindi mabasa ang pangalan sa Japanese; pakitingnan ang box photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Hindi mabasa ang foreign name. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 飲んだ時刻や量は、覚えていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 昨夜九時ごろ、一錠です。箱の表だけを撮ったので、成分の所は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 服用時刻と数量を分かる範囲で伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Alas-nuwebe kagabi, isang tablet. Harap lang ang litrato kaya walang ingredients.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Oras at dami na alam. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 成分や説明が写った資料があれば、診療担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Kung may sangkap at paliwanag na larawan, sa clinician.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 箱は家族が持っています。裏面を撮って送ってもらい、この表の写真と一緒に出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 外箱写真に成分欄がないと気付く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Nasa pamilya ang box. Ipapadala ang likod kasama nitong harap.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Mapansing walang sangkap sa harap. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご家族へ連絡できますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 写真が届きました。こちらが裏です。似た箱の別の薬ではないかも、家族に確かめました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 家族へ裏面写真を依頼して資料を補う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Dumating na. Ito ang likod at natiyak na hindi ibang gamot na kahawig ang kahon.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ipakuha ang likod sa pamilya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その資料をお預かりして担当へ伝えます。受付だけで薬の内容を確定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Tatanggapin namin ang mga impormasyong ito at ipapasa sa medikal na kawani. Hindi matitiyak sa reception lang kung ano mismo ang gamot.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 分かりました。薬名は未確認として、昨夜一錠飲んだことと両方の画像を診察で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 薬を特定したと断言せず両画像を診療担当へ出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Sige, pangalan hindi pa tiyak. Isang tablet kagabi at dalawang larawan ang sa doktor.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Dalawang larawan at hindi tiyak ang pangalan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 服用の情報と画像を担当へ申し送りました。呼出しまで資料をお手元にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Naipasa ang oras at larawan. Hawakan ang materyales hanggang tawag.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: タオルについてのお尋ねですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二枚受け取りました。使った後は、どちらも持って帰ってよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二枚のタオルをどちらも持帰れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Dalawa ang natanggap. Puwedeng parehong iuwi pagkatapos?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong ang parehong iuwi. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お買い上げと貸出しの控えを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Tingnan ang binili at hiniram na slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 小さい一枚は購入、もう一枚は貸出しと書いてあります。同じ受付だったので全部買ったと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 借用一枚と購入一枚の控えを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Maliit binili, isa hiniram. Parehong counter kaya akala lahat binili.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang rental at sale. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 貸出しの方は返却が必要です。こちらに貸出し用の表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hiniram kailangang ibalik. May rental label dito.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この表示のある方ですね。色だけで決めず、表示を見て分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 色だけでなく表示で借用品を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: May ganitong label. Hindi kulay lang, label ang batayan.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Label at hindi kulay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。購入された方はお持ち帰りいただけます。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 借りた方は、使用後どこへ返しますか。受付へ濡れたまま渡してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 使用後の返却場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Saan ibalik ang hiram? Basang ibigay sa reception?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong ang balik. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの返却かごへお願いします。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 借りた方をかごへ返しました。購入した一枚だけを自分の袋へ入れて持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 借用品を返し購入分だけ荷物へ入れる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Naibalik ko na sa basket ang hiniram na tuwalya. Ang isang binili ko lang ang ilalagay ko sa sarili kong bag at iuuwi.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Ibalik at binili lang sa bag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 貸出し分の返却を確認しました。お忘れ物を確認してお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Natiyak ang balik, tingnan ang gamit pauwi.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 花束のご予約を伺います。お受取りはいつでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 金曜日に受け取りたいです。土曜日の昼に、友人へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 贈る前日に花束を受取る予約を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Biyernes sana at Sabado tanghali sa kaibigan.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Magpareserba para sa araw bago. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 贈る前日にお受取りになるのですね。保管する場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Kukunin po ninyo ang mga bulaklak isang araw bago ninyo ibigay bilang regalo. May lugar po ba kayong mapag-iimbakan nito?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 自宅に置くつもりですが、日が当たる部屋しかありません。受け取ってからの置き方を考えていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 贈呈日と受取希望日を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Sa bahay pero maaraw lang ang kuwarto. Hindi pa inisip ang paglalagyan.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang gift at pickup day. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 置き場所や移動時間も含め、受取日をご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Isaalang-alang ang storage at biyahe sa araw.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 土曜の朝なら、受け取ってすぐ渡せます。予約を土曜日の十時に変更できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自宅で保管場所を確保できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Sabado umaga ay agad ibibigay. Puwedeng Sabado ten o'clock?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Walang storage na angkop. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その時刻に準備できるか確認します。花束の内容は同じでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 内容は同じです。付けるカードは、おめでとうではなく、ありがとうにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 贈呈当日の受取へ変更可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Opo, pero thank you sa card at hindi congratulations.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong ang mismong araw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 土曜十時でご用意できます。カードもありがとうに直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Puwede ang Saturday ten at thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 土曜十時に受け取って、そのまま友人の所へ行きます。カードはありがとうでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 変更後の日時とカード文を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Kunin sa ten at diretso sa kaibigan. Thank you ang card.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang bago at card. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 受取日と時刻、カードの変更で承りました。この控えを当日お持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Tanggap ang araw, oras at card; dalhin ang slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 給与の資料を整理されているのですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三月分の明細と、四月の入金履歴があります。月が違うので、別々の収入として書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 同じ給与の明細と翌月入金をどう示すか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: March payslip at April deposit. Ibang buwan kaya magkahiwalay na income ang sulat?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong ang sahod at next month deposit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それぞれの対象と支払日が分かる資料を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Tingnan ang sakop at pay date.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 明細は三月に働いた分で、振込日は四月五日です。会社の説明では、その給与の入金です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 勤務対象月と入金日を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: March work at April five ang pay. Sabi ng kumpanya iyon ang deposit ng sahod.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang month at paydate. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 勤務した月と入金した月が違うことを、担当へ説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ipaliwanag ang magkaibang buwan sa kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 同じ給与なのに二つ足したメモを作っていました。その計算は未確認として出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二件分として足したメモの誤りを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Naidagdag kong dalawa sa note kahit pareho. Ipapakita bilang hindi pa nasuri ang kalkulasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang dobleng note. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 対応する明細と入金履歴を、別の収入と決めずに示しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ipakita ang katugma at hindi ibang income ang agad pasya.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 同じ番号を二つの資料に付けて、明細一枚と履歴の一行を対にして見せてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 対応を確かめる資料の提示方法を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Parehong numero sa dalawa at isang payslip sa isang row ng history, puwede?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pares na pagpapakita. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご自分の整理として印を付け、元の資料も残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Marka bilang sariling ayos at panatilihin ang original.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 元の資料を持参します。対象月、支払日、同じ給与という会社の説明を示して、記入する金額は担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 金額を自己計算せず明細と履歴を対にして相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Dadalhin ko ang mga orihinal na dokumento. Ipapakita ko ang buwan ng trabaho, petsa ng bayad, at paliwanag ng kumpanya na iisang sahod ito. Sa kawani ko titiyakin kung anong halaga ang isusulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Hindi sariling kalkulasyon, pares sa kawani. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: その資料の対応で相談できます。計算したメモも、未確認と分かるよう添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Puwede ang pares na konsultasyon, pati note na malinaw hindi pa tiyak.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 返品についてのご相談でしょうか。

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この服は二千円だったので、二千円を現金で返してもらえると思いました。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入額全額を現金で返してもらうと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo, two thousand ang damit kaya akala cash na two thousand ang balik.
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang akalang full cash. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず購入時のお支払いを確認します。レシートにはポイント利用とありますね。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Titingnan muna namin kung paano kayo nagbayad noong binili ito. Nakasaad sa resibo na gumamit kayo ng points.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五百円分をポイント、残り千五百円を現金で払いました。全部を現金で払ったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ポイント五百円分と現金千五百円の支払内訳を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nagbayad ako gamit ang points na katumbas ng limang daang yen, at ang natitirang isang libo at limang daang yen ay cash. Hindi ko binayaran lahat nang cash.
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itama ang detalye ng bayad: points na katumbas ng limang daang yen at cash na isang libo at limang daang yen. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返品の可否と、受け付けた場合の返し方を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tiyakin kung puwedeng return at kung paano.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 現金二千円が戻ると決めずに説明を聞きます。ポイント分の扱いも、現金とは別に教えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返品可否と返し方の説明を求めポイント扱いも別に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ipagpapalagay cash na two thousand. Hiwalay rin points na paliwanag.
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang return at bawat paraan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。購入時に使用した会員の画面はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin sa kawani. May membership screen na ginamit?

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この会員画面です。残高だけで返却済みとは判断せず、この購入の記録で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会員画面を示し残高だけでなく該当購入記録で確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ito, hindi balance lang na refunded, kundi purchase record ang gusto.
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Member screen at purchase record, hindi balance lang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: レシートと会員の記録を照合してご案内します。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itutugma ang receipt at member record.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。返品が受け付けられるかを先に確認し、現金分とポイント分の結果をそれぞれ聞いてから帰ります。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返品受付と現金分ポイント分の各結果を確認してから帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Return muna, tapos hiwalay na cash at points result bago umuwi.
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Bawat resulta bago uwi. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。商品、レシート、お支払いの内訳を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Susuriin ng namamahalang kawani ang produkto, resibo, at detalye ng inyong pagbabayad.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらがお飲み物二つです。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。子どもが欲しがっているので、このカップを渡してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 子どもへ渡すカップを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Salamat, gusto ng bata, puwedeng ibigay itong cup?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang cup sa bata. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらは大人の方のコーヒーです。まだ熱いのでご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ito po ang kape para sa nakatatanda. Mainit pa ito, kaya mag-ingat po kayo.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ふたが同じなので、子どもの飲み物と思いました。まだ渡していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 似たふたで取り違えたが未手渡しだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Pareho ang lid kaya akala kanya. Hindi pa naibigay.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Parehong lid pero hindi pa naibigay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: もう一方がご注文のりんごジュースです。容器の表示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Isa ang apple juice, label din tingnan.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 表示はここですね。コーヒーを子どもの席から離して置きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 表示を見て大人の飲料を離して置きたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Dito ang label. Ilalayo ang coffee sa upuan ng bata.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Tingnan ang label at sabihin na gusto mong ilayo ang inumin ng nakatatanda sa bata. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの安定した位置へ置けます。テーブルの端は避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Dito matatag at hindi gilid ng mesa.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ジュースのふたを開けるのは私がします。飲む前に中身を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 親が開けて飲む前に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ako ang bubukas ng juice, laman muna bago inom.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Magulang ang magbubukas at susuri. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。お子さんにも、こちらが自分の飲み物だとお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Sabihin din sa bata na ito ang kanya.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: りんごジュースと確認できました。コーヒーは私の側に置き、二つを取り違えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 二つの中身と置き場所を区別して確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Apple juice natiyak. Coffee sa akin para hindi magkapalit.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang laman at puwesto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: その置き方でどうぞ。必要なものがあればお声がけください。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 家の鍵を一本増やしたいです。この二本のうち、どちらを渡せばよいか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二本のうち家の鍵を複製したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Isang dagdag para sa bahay. Hindi alam alin sa dalawa ang ibibigay.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Dalawang susi at bahay ang copy. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お客様ご自身でも、用途が分からない状態でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hindi rin alam ang gamit ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 形が似ていて、片方は自転車の鍵です。家族が付けた印を見れば分かるはずです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 似た形で本人も用途不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Kahawig at bisikleta ang isa. Sa marka ng pamilya malalaman.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Kahawig at hindi alam agad. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 先に用途をご確認ください。確認してから、作製できる種類か調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Tiyakin muna saka kung kayang gawin.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 家族へ聞くと、青い印が家用でした。もう一本は自転車で、増やす必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 使用時の印を家族へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Sabi ng pamilya blue ang bahay. Bisikleta ang isa at hindi kailangan ng dagdag.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sa pamilya ang marka. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 青い印の一本を拝見します。ご希望の本数は一本ですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。この家用だけです。今の種類がここで作れるか、先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 家用と確認した一本だけの対応可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Opo, bahay lang. Puwede rito ang ganitong uri, tiyakin muna.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Bahay lang at kayang gawin? Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 担当が種類と受付条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Susuriin ng namamahalang kawani ang uri ng susi at ang mga kondisyon para tanggapin ang pagpapagawa.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 家用一本の相談としてお願いします。自転車の鍵は渡さず、自分の袋へ戻しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 種類確認の受付を頼み別鍵は持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Isang pangbahay ang konsultasyon. Hindi ibibigay ang bisikleta at nasa bag ko na.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Tanggap na uri at sariling balik ng iba. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 用途を確認した一本を担当へお預かりしました。作製の可否と条件をご案内するまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Tinanggap ang natiyak na isa at hintayin ang kaya at kondisyon.
